Only 22% of remote design listings disclose pay. But the ones that do? Up to $5,000 per project. Here's what 2026 looks like for brand designers.

Among 3,940 active remote listings on Loker Dollar, just 22% list a salary. Two brand-design roles that do: Stevens pays $3,000–$5,000 fixed; Sidekicks Creative Studio pays $1,500–$3,000. Both worldwide remote.

Also live: WTP Global video edits at $800–$1,200, Love Isn't Blind editor at $1,000–$2,000/month, South Digital ops lead at $2,000–$4,000/month.

64% of listings accept worldwide remote applicants, so the talent pool is global. For freelancers, published rates give a clearer benchmark than private negotiations.

Contrarian take: a $3,000–$5,000 fixed sprint isn't always better than a $1,500–$3,000 retainer. Consider scope, timeline, and revision policy.

Ready to apply? Two brand roles are open now. Details in the full analysis.
